name: Equitas Small Finance Bank Limited
methodologies: Assigning Outlook or Rating Watch to Credit Ratings.md
step12_scaling_decision: Bank -> LENDING model built in full (pre-flight [1c]): Assumptions, Lending P&L, Balance Sheet, Capital (RWA/CRAR), Credit Ratios [formulas], Scenarios (base / MFI-type stress / tail + breakeven credit cost for CRAR 15%), Debt Breakup (funding mix, instruments, rated vs drawn), Valuation (market P/B - flexibility only). The corporate 3-statement template does not fit a lender. Tasks 1 and 3 combined into one credit-focused research note; Task 4 = 6 charts; no DCF, comps or price target (book value and capital access are the credit-relevant measures for a bank). Task 5 not run.
